author: kevaundray
content:
<@1391753260544557126> spent some more time looking at the networking that needs to be done/figured out and the unknowns and I think having leanVM depend on this poses a significant risk to the timeline, given it’s the component that all other layers depend on and there’s a lot of hardening work that needs to be done for us to have high confidence that it’s secure including making sure the proof system specs are correct (before even checking the implementation) and then starting audits

We’re now moving to hardening, but if there is a small change needed to make the difference between pq gasper and pq dc, then it sounds okay to reconsider
